'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[June 2024 northern Gaza City airstrikes]]
****At least 42 [[Palestinian]]s are killed by [[Israel]]i airstrikes in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-body-dead-39d09eccc39a7f225d573c97e73a2917 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strikes-kill-least-42-gaza-enclaves-government-media-office-says-2024-06-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***At least three people are killed and 38 others are injured when [[Russia]]n [[guided bomb]]s hit [[civilian]] infrastructure in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/06/22/russia-ukraine-war-energy-missiles-drones/f179e904-3071-11ef-bcdf-31cdebd3022f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***Russia launches [[missile]] and [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] across Ukraine, injuring two people and damaging [[Energy in Ukraine|energy infrastructure]]. Ukraine says that it shot down 12 of 16 missiles and all 13 drones. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-downs-12-missiles-all-drones-launched-by-russia-new-attack-2024-06-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021–2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
**At least 23 people are killed by [[CODECO]] militia groups in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/militia-kills-least-23-people-eastern-congo-village-attacks-2024-06-22/ (Reuters)]
*At least seven people are killed and 100 are kidnapped by unknown gunmen in [[Katsina State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/23/dead-dozens-missing-after-gunmen-attack-in-northern-nigeria (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Tamil Nadu alcohol poisoning]]
**The death toll from the [[moonshine|tainted liquor]] incident in [[Kallakurichi district]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]], increases to 54. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/22/tainted-alcohols-death-toll-rises-to-54-in-indias-tamil-nadu (Al Jazeera)]
*The death toll from the storms and heavy rains in [[El Salvador]], [[Guatemala]], and [[Honduras]] increases to 30 people, including at least six children. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-30-dead-torrential-rains-lash-central-america-2024-06-21/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are missing following thunderstorms and landslides in southeastern [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/22/3-missing-in-a-landslide-in-swiss-alps-as-heavy-rains-cause-flash-floods (Al Jazeera)]
*A severe water crisis on the island of [[Capri]], [[Italy]], due to Italian mainland water system failures causes several areas in [[Anacapri]] to run dry, and forces the mayor of Capri to suspend tourist arrivals on the island. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-capri-water-emergency-tourists-halt-cc3ea8ea5fce0f63ddeb1c20a2f3bd5c (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Antisemitism in 21st-century France]]
**French prosecutors charge a 19-year-old and a minor with planning and collecting arms for a violent "[[Terrorism in France|terrorist conspiracy]]" against [[Jews|Jewish]] targets. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20240622-teens-charged-in-france-for-allegedly-planning-to-attack-jewish-targets (France 24)]

**Thousands of people march in a pride parade in [[Budapest]], [[Hungary]], to protest against [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]]'s anti-LGBTQ+ policies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/thousands-join-budapest-pride-protest-anti-lgbtq-policies-2024-06-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A [[University of Illinois]] team lead by [[Joshua Wurman]] and Karen Kosiba confirms [[Doppler on Wheels|mobile radar measurements]] of between {{cvt|309|mph|km/h|abbr=on}} and {{cvt|318|mph|km/h|abbr=on}} in the [[Tornado outbreak sequence of May 19–27, 2024#Nodaway–Corning–Greenfield, Iowa|tornado]] that struck [[Greenfield, Iowa|Greenfield]], [[Iowa]], [[United States]], on May 21. This is the first unambiguous radar confirmation of tornado winds over {{cvt|300|mph|km/h|abbr=on}}. [https://www.nbcnews.com/science/environment/storm-chasers-catch-tornado-300-mph-winds-rcna158040 (NBC News)] [https://x.com/dowfacility/status/1804575739330613507 (University of Illinois)]
